resources.string: Your rally game. On your Quest.
To play, you need the data from your own PC copy of Colin McRae Rally 2.0. Import it once onto this Quest.
1 ZIP the entire installed game folder on your PC.\n2 Copy the ZIP to your Quest’s Download folder using USB.\n3 Select the ZIP here. We will check and import your files.
Your files stay on your devices. Next time, the game starts directly. To import again, open “OpenCMR2 VR · Game data” in your app library.
Your existing game data will only be replaced after a successful check. Saved games and settings will be kept.
No file picker is available on this Quest. Update Horizon OS and try again.
You can start the import again later. Your existing game data will be kept.
